data.one_liner: Rive runtime for Flutter to display and control interactive vector animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to load Rive files, control artboards, state machines and render animations. Supports multiple renderers and platforms including web and desktop.
use_when: You need high‑performance, interactive vector animations created in Rive
You target multiple platforms (mobile, web, desktop) with a single runtime
avoid_when: You only need simple, static animations and want a smaller package
You require a pure Dart solution without native dependencies
strengths: Cross‑platform support including web and desktop
Fine‑grained control over renderers and resolution
weaknesses: Requires native library setup on some platforms
Package size larger due to native binaries
Limited to animations created with the Rive editor
data.setup_notes: Native libraries are downloaded automatically; may need to run `dart run rive_native:setup` for custom builds or troubleshooting.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lottie also renders vector animations from JSON and has a smaller footprint for simple animations.
